title: Research: two-copy raw-record lifecycle and formal bank boundary
body:
## Result

A source-bound **record-level** successor to Ross Richardson's PR #1704 two-copy scatter. The scalar construction, fixed matching and 120-ADD saving are his result, not claimed again here.

The new package emits explicit snapshot roles661/662 in the real raw6 ABI, checks all636 rational frames and2386 containments, and replaces immutable-temporary syntax with exact snapshot equality at every chronological ERASE. A separately implemented C++17 interpreter checks complete5/9/11-stage formal bank maps with independently dirty helper banks for every stage: **2639/4839/5939 columns and45/81/99 ERASEs**.

A meaningful failure control omits restoration: blind deletion leaves all persistent outputs unchanged, but both interpreters reject the earlier ERASE. Nine other controls cover signs, aliasing, source/frame/rank binding, role lifetime and truncated records; all6/18/24 omitted bank bridges reject. The original one-slot stream is a passing control.

## Complete finite bill and scope

- Local ADDs remain PR1704's11380, nine rank7 COPY/ERASE pairs,2911 persistent MOVEs, rank mass5129 and the unchanged local profile.
- Peak snapshot slots1→2 and sum of live COPY ranks7→14 are explicitly exposed.
- Every bank bridge and three-ADD terminal exchange is counted: total scalar ADDs58232/105750/129509 for5/9/11 stages.
- Exact scalar-prefix envelopes, including exchange intermediates, have98/184/228 bits. Only5/9 are tested against inherited104/192 algebraic guards; no11-stage physical allowance is invented.

**No physical address replay, physical two-COPY allocation/nonaliasing, hosted admission, packed precision/tape theorem, supplier adoption, selected-frontier change or new kappa is claimed.** Compiled native execution here means raw-record formal columns; MOVEs receive a separate rational geometry audit, not a fictitious address implementation. The old native immutable-temp checker is unchanged. The README proves the restricted-inverse/common-frame substitution and names its remaining physical premises.

## Reproduce

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -I -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/bit-two-copy-bank-boundary
```

Actually passed on CPython3.12.12 / Apple clang21.0.0, with C++17 `-O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror`, standard library only:

```text
PASS_TWO_COPY_BANK_BOUNDARY records=14309 banks=5,9,11 columns=2639,4839,5939 controls=10 no_physical_admission no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/bit-two-copy-bank-boundary outcome=completed
```

The required helper-star working example also passed. Exact outputs, metadata-preflight corrections, environment and unrun obligations are in VALIDATION.json; canonical RESULT.json is replayed. No hosted CI or independent human review is asserted.

## Provenance, novelty and credit

- Exact base0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea; one OS draw, seed221c3644c3349df6239e718172a57529, bit-mechanisms / bit-helper-contract, explicitly changed to the actual mutable snapshot interface. Complete selection receipt retained.
- PR1704 head7f14aa7285cf10a7be350472fab25a25ef898484 remains unchanged at final live check. Its prior independent scalar audit is credited; this work adds the emitted-record boundary and staged executable evidence, not another matching census.
- Final shared cached overlap covered584 open PRs and565 discussion records with complete pagination, plus targeted live head and local predecessor reads; coverage limitations are recorded.
- [Round-two claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1929#discussioncomment-18925928).
- Credit Ross Richardson/PR1704; Sagar Thakrar/PR1062; PR967,926,1015,923; DreamingOfClouds/PR589; eumemic/PR555; Dylan Crow's exporter/native adaptation; DaysSky's bank schedule; and woklerx's chronological COPY and semantic-D work. Full attribution in README.

Only `research/bit-two-copy-bank-boundary/` changes. Prepared for Adam Gall with substantial OpenAI Codex GPT-6 Astra assistance; Apache-2.0. Selected and frozen inputs remain unchanged.
